rationale: SYK gapped down ~7.6% on an earnings miss and is now trading at 90% of today's range near the session high, suggesting the initial selling has been absorbed but the stock is extended from VWAP ($290.41) and the 9-EMA ($291.02) after a significant bounce from the $282.18 low. With two working orders already consuming buying power and today's realized P&L already negative, the asymmetry does not favor adding exposure at this location.
